Memory grows as new interactions distill into the five-dimension format. For Echo-MC, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of transferable experience units along five knowledge dimensions: structure, attribute, process, function, interaction.

During operation, Echo-MC applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to transferable experience units along five knowledge dimensions: structure, attribute, process, function, interaction; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (transferable experience units along five knowledge dimensions: structure, attribute, process, function, interaction) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
